title: [BUG] API Error: 403 You don't have access to the model with the specified model ID. when operating with local files
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [ ] Anthropic API - [x] AWS Bedrock - [ ] Google Vertex AI - [ ] Other: - Claude CLI version: 0.2.45 (Claude Code) - Operating System: macOS 15.1.1 - Terminal: Warp ## Bug Description When Claude tries to operate with local files I see error API Error: 403 You don't have access to the model with the specified model ID. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Ask Claude to create local folder 2. it will try and below the output line it will say API Error: 403 You don't have access to the model with the specified model ID. 3. but overall it manages to create files ## Expected Behavior No error is shown and whatever action this error prevents is executed successfully ## Additional Context CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 ANTHROPIC_MODEL=anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0 DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING=1 AWS_REGION=us-west-2
author: gaiar
